# weave

> An open-source, self-hosted alternative to Airtable, Fibery, Notion databases,
> and ClickUp, in which AI agents are first-class users. Connected tables,
> bidirectional relations, workflow states, lookups, rollups, formulas,
> automations, and per-entity markdown documents — one SQLite file, zero runtime
> dependencies, no build step, MIT licensed.

weave runs as a single Node process over a single `.db` file. Everything the web
UI can do is also available over a REST API, a scriptable CLI, and a built-in
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server backed by the same engine. There is no
cloud, no signup, and no telemetry. It has no authentication of its own: a
self-hosted instance is expected to sit behind a reverse proxy, SSO proxy, or
private network.

Requires Node ≥ 22.16 (Node 24 LTS recommended). Install is `git clone` — there
is nothing to build and nothing to install from npm.

- [Feature parity matrix](https://github.com/grunion-ai/weave/blob/main/docs/PARITY.md): weave against Fibery's core work-platform feature set, feature by feature
- [weave vs Airtable](https://github.com/grunion-ai/weave/blob/main/docs/comparison/airtable.md): how Airtable concepts map onto weave, and what is missing
- [weave vs Fibery](https://github.com/grunion-ai/weave/blob/main/docs/comparison/fibery.md): how Fibery concepts map onto weave, and what is missing
- [Open-source alternatives compared](https://github.com/grunion-ai/weave/blob/main/docs/comparison/alternatives.md): weave against NocoDB, Baserow, Grist, and Teable
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/grunion-ai/weave/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, the zero-dependency and no-build-step rules, PR expectations
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/grunion-ai/weave/blob/main/SECURITY.md): threat model, what is in scope, private reporting
